<article class="group-map" data-product="maxt_departure_daily" data-tab="maxt" data-variant="daily" data-option="Daily"><h2 class="group-map-heading">Maximum temperature departure</h2>
<a href="../maps/generated/prism/temperature/maxt-departure-latest.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="../maps/generated/prism/temperature/maxt-departure-latest.png" alt="Maximum temperature departure" loading="lazy"></a>
<p>The latest daily maximum temperature is compared with the 1991-2020 average maximum for the same calendar date, estimated with a centered five-day window. Positive values mean warmer-than-average afternoons and negative values mean cooler-than-average afternoons, in degrees F.</p>
<p><a href="../maps/generated/prism/temperature/maxt-departure-latest.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open full-resolution PNG</a></p>

<a href="../maps/generated/prism/temperature/tmean-departure-latest.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="../maps/generated/prism/temperature/tmean-departure-latest.png" alt="Mean temperature departure" loading="lazy"></a>
<p>The latest daily mean temperature, calculated from maximum and minimum temperature, is compared with its 1991-2020 average for the same calendar date using a centered five-day window. Positive values mean warmer-than-average conditions and negative values mean cooler-than-average conditions, in degrees F.</p>
<p><a href="../maps/generated/prism/temperature/tmean-departure-latest.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open full-resolution PNG</a></p>

<p>The latest daily minimum temperature is compared with the 1991-2020 average minimum for the same calendar date, estimated with a centered five-day window. Positive values mean warmer-than-average nights and negative values mean colder-than-average nights, in degrees F.</p>
<p><a href="../maps/generated/prism/temperature/mint-departure-latest.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open full-resolution PNG</a></p>

<p>The average of the latest 30 daily maximum temperatures is compared with the average of their matching centered-five-day 1991-2020 calendar-day normals. Positive values show sustained warmer-than-average afternoons and negative values show sustained cooler-than-average afternoons, in degrees F.</p>

<p>The average of the latest 30 daily mean temperatures is compared with the average of their matching centered-five-day 1991-2020 calendar-day normals. Positive values show sustained warmer-than-average conditions and negative values show sustained cooler-than-average conditions, in degrees F.</p>

<p>The average of the latest 30 daily minimum temperatures is compared with the average of their matching centered-five-day 1991-2020 calendar-day normals. Positive values show sustained warmer-than-average nights and negative values show sustained colder-than-average nights, in degrees F.</p>
